title: fix(durability): a refused syncObjectSchema logs error at the messaging, datasource and publish seams; the gate reads .call/.apply/.bind and declares it
body:
Fixes #22985
Clause-②: no (log levels and an existing gate's vocabulary; no accepted shape and no published name changes)

## What this changes

`check:durability-log-level` now sees a refused `syncObjectSchema`, and the four places where one was logged below `error` each give AGENTS.md "Degradation log levels" its measured answer.

| member | site | answer | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5, the gate | `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` | the guarded-side read resolves `.call` / `.apply` / `.bind(recv)(…)` to the function they invoke, through a scope-aware `const` alias; `syncObjectSchema` joins `DURABILITY_CRITICAL_CALLEES` | red on the base members, green after (below); 5 self-test cases, 3 that must light and 2 that must not, each ablated |
| 1 | `service-messaging` `provisionSystemTables` | `error`, both halves, once per table per boot, the refusal in meta (mirrors plugin-audit's line) | the pipeline tables are written as a side effect: `approval-service.ts` and `audit-writers.ts` (@mention) catch a failed `emit()` at `warn` and complete, so the action succeeds while its notification never lands |
| 2 | `service-datasource` `connect()` bound-object loop | `error`, both halves, once per object per connect | pinned: after the refusal `connectDeclared` answers `status: 'connected'` and `getConnectionState` reads `connected` |
| 3 | `metadata-protocol` `ensureObjectStorage` | `console.error`, both halves | pinned: `publishMetaItem` answers `success: true` while the object's storage sync was refused |
| 4 | `cli` `measureComposedCoverage` | the caller is told: declared in `FAILURE_PROPAGATION_SITES` (`failures.set`, `effect`); the cli source is unchanged | not a durability seam (see below) |

### The gate (member 5)

`calleeName()` is untouched; the read-seam rule and helper following still use it. A new `guardedCriticalCallee()` is used only by `collectGuardedCalls`. It reads the invoked operation first and the plain `calleeName()` second, so reach is only added. Scope rules for the alias: the nearest enclosing declaration wins, and a parameter, a `catch` binding, a loop variable or a function declaration of the same name shadows it. Only a `const` is an alias, because a `let` can be reassigned. A bare `.bind(recv)` invokes nothing, so it is not a guarded call. No new rule and no new gate.

Measured on the tree, in order:

| state | seams | red |
|---|---|---|
| base `edecd4485` | 46 | 0 |
| unwrap only, vocabulary unchanged | 46 | 0 (no existing seam lost or gained) |
| `syncObjectSchema` entry only, no unwrap (scratch copy) | 49 | 3: members 2, 3, 4. Member 1 and the audit site are invisible because `sync.call` reads as `call` |
| gate change `a91725f9e` (unwrap + entry), members unfixed | 51 | 4: members 1–4. The audit site is a seam and loud |
| merged `7d7de7be4`, members answered | 51 | 0 (7 propagating, declared) |

Red run at `a91725f9e`, `--list` filtered to the five `syncObjectSchema` seams:

```
packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.ts:2401  guards syncObjectSchema()@2399  → SILENT
packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:19405  guards syncObjectSchema()@19404  → QUIET (warn@19406)
packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts:653  guards syncObjectSchema()@652  → loud (error@660)
packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-connection-service.ts:658  guards syncObjectSchema()@657  → QUIET (warn@659)
packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts:491  guards syncObjectSchema()@490  → QUIET (warn@492)
✗ 4 durability report(s) degrade quietly
```

Green, on the merged head:

```
✓ durability-degradation log levels: 51 durability-critical catch seam(s), all loud, rethrowing or propagating to the caller (7 propagating, declared); 2 counter-guarded summary report(s) outside a catch, all of them able to print against a sink with no `error` (#9748).
```

### Member 2: why `error`, and what it does not claim

The catch cannot tell a managed object from a federated one, and both end up registered and served with no working storage while the datasource reads `connected`. A managed object's DDL never ran. A federated object's remote-table binding was never installed, so its reads go to a table named after the object. The loop only runs from `connectDeclared`: runtime-admin connects pass no objects. Every boot calls `connectDeclared`, so the fix the line names is "resolve the refusal, then restart". `os migrate` is not named, because it plans only the primary datasource and its telemetry sibling (`schema-migrate.ts`). For a federated object, `ObjectQLPlugin.reconcileFederatedBindings` re-drives the binding at `kernel:ready` and reports what is still unbound at `error`. A federated refusal can therefore print twice, and both lines are true. The logger contract has `warn` required and `error` optional, so the call is spelled `(logger.error ?? logger.warn).call(logger, …)`, never `error?.(…)`. A pin holds the `{ warn }`-only sink.

### Member 4: delivery shape, measured

- The catch has no `return`. It runs `failed++` and `failures.set(message, …)`, then falls off the end. After the loop, every `failures` entry becomes one note of the returned `{ coverage, notes }`. `os migrate plan` / `apply` print those notes (`plan.ts`, `apply.ts`) next to `coverage.reasons.failed`. That is the CALL shape, which AGENTS.md declares through the propagation vocabulary. It is the same shape as `duplicatePackage`'s `failed.push`.
- The repo's own instrument agrees. With `syncObjectSchema` in the vocabulary, `measure-return-propagating-durability-seams.mjs --sites` lists 0 members in "[1] the gate SEES this seam today", so this catch is not a RETURN-shaped member.
- It is not a durability seam at all. This pass runs only on a boot that DEFERRED its DDL, so the guarded call registers metadata in memory and writes nothing.
- The existing pin `schema-migration-plugins.test.ts` › "reports a REFUSING driver as a shortfall, quoting it" holds `reasons.failed` and the note.
- No checker change was needed to excuse it, and no ⛔ move was made: no baseline entry, no `logger.error`, no `DURABILITY_CRITICAL_CALLEES` entry for the site.

## Pins and ablations

Each `error` member has a forced-refusal test that asserts exactly one line, naming the subject and the remedy. The line has no newline, and the refusal travels in meta or as a separate argument. Each also asserts no quieter duplicate and has a CONTROL in which a clean run logs no `error`. Every negative pin was ablated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. In each leg the anchor hit once, the blob changed, and the restore was proven: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

| leg (mutation) | red | at |
|---|---|---|
| messaging `error` → `warn` | 8 of 9 (every object; CONTROL green) | `8a59d7e0a` |
| datasource fallback → `logger.warn.call` | 2 of 4 | `8a59d7e0a` |
| datasource fallback → `logger.error?.call` | 1 of 4 (the `{ warn }`-only sink) | `8a59d7e0a` |
| protocol `console.error` → `console.warn` | 1 of 6 (CONTROL and the four existing cases green) | `d80c6d124` |
| gate: guarded read back to plain `calleeName` | 3 self-test cases (`sync.call` flags; cast alias is a seam; apply/bind ×3) | `8a59d7e0a` |
| gate: bare `.bind` read as an invocation | the must-not-light bind case | `8a59d7e0a` |
| gate: parameter no longer shadows | the must-not-light shadow case | `8a59d7e0a` |
| gate: `let` trusted as alias | the must-not-light shadow case | `8a59d7e0a` |
| gate: member 4's site key renamed | real tree red at the cli site + a stale-site report | `8a59d7e0a` |

## Files beyond the claim's surface, and why

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.record-package-commit-durability.test.ts`: its stub engine gains `syncObjectSchema`. `HostEngine` declares it, and an object publish calls it. Without it the publish threw a TypeError, which the protocol now reports at `error`, so the file's "logs nothing" control went red (7 failures, measured). The alternative, a `typeof` guard in `ensureObjectStorage`, would have been consumer-side tolerance of an off-contract engine.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.publish-side-effects-canonical-type.test.ts`: member 3's pin lives here. Its stub already carries the publish path and is already in both double ledgers. A copied stub in a new file reddened `check:engine-double-contract` (3 RETAINED) and `check:objectql-double-limit` (1 BLIND). The stub's `syncObjectSchema` now takes a set of refused names.
- `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs`: a by-value copy of the gate vocabulary, self-tested against it. `check:swallow-census-controls` reds on the drift until the copy gains `syncObjectSchema`.
- `ensureObjectStorage`'s docblock gained two sentences, beside its catch.

## Verification

Checks run at `7d7de7be4` (`origin/main` merged once, at `7d7de7be4`; full `turbo run build` after the merge):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test`: 48 files, 549 passed; `typecheck` green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test`: 43 files, 769 passed; `typecheck` green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run`: 227 files passed, 3 skipped; 28192 passed; `typecheck` green.
- `tsc --listFiles` includes each touched test file in its package's program.
- Gates: the 89 commands `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives for this change set (it includes everything the dispatch listed except `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity`, which were run as well), plus `measure-return-propagating-durability-seams.mjs --self-test` and `measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs --self-test`. All 93 exited 0, and the exit code was captured before any pipe. `dispatch-gates --ran` with those codes reports `89 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 89 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. This includes `check:durability-log-level` (self-test 68 + 57 cases), `check:swallow-census-controls`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:objectql-double-limit`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`. The last two read built output, so they ran after the post-merge full build.
- Lint, narrowed and proven: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 8 changed `.ts`/`.mjs` files. The JSON lists all 8 as linted and none as ignored: 0 errors, 0 warnings. The population is all of the changed code files, read from eslint's own output. The narrowing cannot move any other file's verdict, because `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules; its own header says so).
- NOT MEASURED:
  - cli tests: no cli source changed, so the `unit` layer is not owed and `integration` is left to CI.
  - Downstream suites that drive the real protocol (`objectql`, `rest`, `runtime`): not run locally. A static read of every test there that spies `console.error` found no count-based assertion over an object publish whose engine lacks `syncObjectSchema`.
  - Member 1 at a public door after the fix (`os serve`): not run. The base-side reading by the #22913 dev stands, and the unit pin holds the level.

## Acceptance notes

- **Observed, not filed (reach not measured):** under `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1`, member 2's loop still issues DDL for a managed object bound to a declared datasource. `connectDeclared` is called unconditionally from `AppPlugin.start()`, and `syncObjectSchema` is ungated. This is the shape #22984 repaired at the two provisioning sites. It is code reading only, with no public-door measurement.
- **Doc drift:** `ObjectQLPlugin.reconcileFederatedBindings`' docblock says `DatasourceConnectionService` re-drives "not at all when `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC` is set". No such gate exists in `AppPlugin` or the connection service.
- The two census instruments (`measure-return-propagating-durability-seams.mjs`, `measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs`) keep their own guarded-call readers, which do not resolve `.call`. They read the gate's vocabulary but are not the gate.
